_about: Replacement-image briefs for after the canary (plan.html section 6). NOT rendered and NOT in this batch's SQL: the kit reads only content.md and meta.json. Render with GPT Image 2.5 on fal, 2 candidates per hero. Proofread card text word for word against content.md at that time, since the post may change. The nutrition and timeline cards are not here: they are briefs in meta.json at new URLs, and the nutrition card takes the plan's what helps slot.
plan_row: Pubic swelling: swelling area diagram, normal vs call card and garment folded on a chair remain for later, at the same address after the canary passes, plus the hero.
method: After the tightness canary passes, save the current files, then use blog/tools/images/overwrite_same_path.mjs <live url> <local.jpg> --backup-dir DIR. These files sit on the older Blob store, so check that the token reaches it first. Do the hero first: 2dloln is both the hero and an inline image, so the new hero must be live at a new URL before 2dloln is overwritten with the garment photo.

images.prompt: SCENE: Mid-morning in a bright Miami living room, white plaster walls, a tall arched window with sheer linen curtains, soft palm shadows on a pale limestone floor. Palette of stone, sand, warm white and brushed gold. SUBJECT: A woman in her mid forties with olive skin and shoulder-length dark hair, resting on a linen sofa with a soft pillow behind her back, in loose sand-colored loungewear, a cup of tea on the side table. Three-quarter view, calm, looking toward the window. KEY DETAILS: Whole upper body in frame with generous space above her head, subject in the upper two thirds; editorial documentary photography, 50mm, natural color, real skin texture, gentle depth of field, fine film grain. CONSTRAINTS: Modest loungewear fully covering the torso; no swimwear, lingerie, cleavage or bare midriff; no garments, bandages, drains or incisions; not photographed from behind; no body-part framing; no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks; not glamour, not a fashion ad.
